data.title: 2026 IMS | IASO Bio Presents First-in-Human Phase 1 Data of RD140, a Fully Human BCMA/GPRC5D Dual-Targeted FasT CAR-T
data.description: A poster presentation has been chosen for the poster discussion session with Abstract No. PA-200. The presentation discusses a first-in-human study involving 9 heavily pretreated, high-risk patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma or plasma cell leukemia. The study focuses on RD140, which is a fully human BCMA/GPRC5D dual-targeted FasT CAR-T therapy.

data.title: New ProWood Product Named BobVila.com 2026 Tool of the Year Award Winner

data.title: AMG Critical Materials N.V. Publishes Annex IX Information Document ahead of Listing on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange
data.description: In Amsterdam on September 25, 2026, AMG Critical Materials N.V. shared an Annex IX info document related to its shares being listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange under EURONEXT AMSTERDAM: “AMG”. This move is in accordance with Article 1(5)(ba) of Regulation (EU) 2017/1129. The decision to pursue a listing on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange was revealed on August 24, 2026.

data.title: SMB study: Small banks lead in AI - but scale lags
data.description: The adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in the information technology sector has reached 64%, showing significant growth. However, challenges related to infrastructure and governance are impeding further widespread deployment of AI technologies. To address this issue, a new tool has been developed to assist institutions in evaluating their current standing in terms of AI integration. This development comes as SMB sector particularly small banks, credit unions, and lenders increasingly rely on AI technologies to streamline their operations. The tool is intended to provide insights and guidance for institutions looking to enhance their use of AI in their processes and services.

data.title: Duke Energy Foundation awards $100,000 to support upward mobility in Florida
data.description: In St. Petersburg, Florida on September 25, 2026, the Duke Energy Foundation announced a significant contribution of $100,000 to support three nonprofit organizations. These organizations are focusing on enhancing leadership development, career readiness, and entrepreneurship opportunities in Central Florida and the Tampa Bay area. The foundation believes in the importance of investing in these areas to empower individuals and communities for a brighter future.

data.title: NCL GT20 CANADA TO STAGE 2026 TOURNAMENT IN THE CARIBBEAN
data.description: The collaborative 2026 Caribbean edition aims to enhance the connection between Canadian and West Indies cricket, paving the way for the tournament's reoccurrence in Canada in 2027. The NCL GT20 Canada, a prominent Canadian professional T20 franchise tournament, is set to host its 2026 edition. This edition will feature matches in the Caribbean region, underscoring the growing integration between the two regions. The tournament's upcoming return to Canada in 2027 further underscores the strengthening ties and mutual benefits for both Canadian and West Indies cricket.

data.title: Florida Poly unveils designs for new Student Achievement Center
data.description: In Lakeland, Florida, on September 25, 2026, Florida Polytechnic University unveiled plans for its upcoming Student Achievement Center (StAC). This innovative facility is set to be a modern and visually appealing hub for student activities, expected to enhance student life on campus. The StAC is projected to play a pivotal role in supporting the university's growing student population and academic programs.
